senses.sense_definition: The desire or need of customers for goods or services which they want to buy or use.

examples.text: Prices usually go up when <w>demand</w> exceeds supply.

senses.sense_definition: Something that requires a lot of effort, skill, or time to deal with successfully.

examples.text: His new job makes many <w>demands</w> on his time and energy.
